description.value: Wells Gray Inn is a 34-room hotel centrally located on Highway 5 in Clearwater, positioned as a base for exploring Wells Gray Provincial Park's mountains, rivers, and waterfalls. The inn features on-site dining through a diner with room service, Monroe's Fine Dining Restaurant and Lounge, and a bar and grill, as well as an outdoor hot tub, infrared sauna, and massage therapist for post-ride recovery. Summer activities in the area include biking, rafting, canoeing, and hiking.
